title: All-in-one Claude Code repo with 28 agents, 119 skills, and 60 commands.
description:
"Everything Claude Code" is a comprehensive GitHub repository designed to transform Claude Code into a fully capable engineering team immediately upon installation. With over 182,000 stars, this repo was developed at Anthropx's hackathon and integrates an extensive set of features, including 28 specialized sub-agents, 119 skills, 60 slash commands, 34 operational rules, 20 automated hooks, and 14 MCP servers. Its broad capabilities encompass security scanning, memory optimization, continuous learning, and research-driven development. The product insight lies in consolidating diverse functionalities and automations into a single, battle-tested, and high-coverage codebase, streamlining the development process for users. Supporting multiple AI engines such as Claude Code, Codex, CursorOpen, and Cloud Gemini, it ensures versatility and broad integration potential. The combination of scale, depth, and cross-platform compatibility explains its viral success and growing developer adoption, offering significant efficiency and productivity value to engineering teams and AI practitioners. #ClaudeCode #AIEngineering #GitHub
#Automation #DevTools #MachineLearning #CodingAI #SoftwareDevelopment #OpenSource #TechInnovation #AIProductivity #CodeOptimization #ContinuousLearning #SecurityScanning #DeveloperTools
